rule.title: Educator expenses are an adjustment only for an eligible educator

when_missing.because: A client who records educator expenses is an eligible educator unless a preparer says otherwise

citation.wording: If you were an eligible educator in 2025, you can deduct on line 11 up to $300 of qualified expenses you paid in 2025.

rule.open_point: The $300 limit ($600 when both spouses filing jointly are eligible, $300 each) is NOT applied: the record's row places on Form 1040 line 10 with every other adjustment, so a cap on that line would cap them all. It needs the row addressed to Schedule 1 line 11.
